Name: Bench Press
Description: Lie on a flat bench, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width, lower it to your chest, and push it back up.

Name: Incline Dumbbell Press
Description: Sit on an incline bench, press dumbbells upward from chest level until arms are extended.

Name: Barbell Squat
Description: Rest a barbell on your upper back, drop your hips down until thighs are parallel to the floor, then drive back up.

Name: Romanian Deadlift
Description: Hold a barbell at hip height, hinge at your hips while keeping legs relatively straight, lowering the weight to mid-shin.

Name: Pull-Up
Description: Hang from a bar with palms facing away, pull your body up until your chin clears the bar.

Name: Barbell Row
Description: Hinge forward at the hips holding a barbell, pull the bar toward your lower chest keeping elbows close to your body.

Name: Overhead Press
Description: Press a barbell from shoulder height directly overhead until arms are completely locked out.

Name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
Description: Stand straight with dumbbells at your sides, raise arms outward to the sides until parallel with the floor.
